Thanks again for the time today, Jordan — great conversation and appreciate the product walkthrough. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Discovery notes: Novapay is planning an initial pilot targeting fraud-detection enrichment (synchronous calls) and a small async batch embedding job for search.
- Expected steady-state token profile (per month): ~1.2B total tokens (1.05B generation, 150M embedding) with expected 10-15% month-over-month growth during Q3.
- Your target unit economics: mentioned target around $4.5k per 1M tokens (you clarified this is a pilot vs. longer-term negotiated pricing).
- Other asks: procurement will need a simple invoice estimate + cost breakdown (compute, storage, support), and a pilot contract (3 months).

Action items I’ll take:
1) Put together a conservative invoice estimate and a cost-model spreadsheet (attached draft calculator).
2) Call out assumptions (token definitions, response length assumptions, batching/latency targets) so procurement can see the unit math.
3) Share a one-page summary for exec review and an attached cost-model for procurement.

Attached: novapay_pricing_calculator_v1.xlsx (draft pricing calculator) — use this to sanity-check numbers.

Proposed next step: I’ll send the formal invoice estimate tomorrow; can we lock a 30-min sync with procurement next week if needed?

Thanks,

Thanks Sean — appreciate the recap. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Volume: starting pilot expectation is ~1.2B tokens/month. For the pilot we plan to run the higher-volume synchronous workload (approx 1B gen tokens) and smaller embedding batches (approx 200M tokens).
- Pilot length: 3 months. If pilot meets performance targets, we’ll consider full rollout.
- Budget: procurement guidance is targeting ~$4,500 per 1M tokens for the pilot phase; we recognize this may be higher than listed public rates if we include enterprise SLA/support.
- Required breakdown: please include compute (GPU), network/storage, support (SRE/priority), and any one-time setup fees. Also include estimated latency SLO assumptions used to size GPU fleet.

Can you include an invoice estimate for the 3-month pilot and a monthly breakdown? I’ve attached our PO template for reference.

Jordan

Novapay

Subject: Re: Novapay — Pricing & Invoice Estimate (post-demo follow-up)

Jordan — thanks, attaching the formal estimate and the cost-model workbook. High level summary first:

- Assumptions: 1.2B monthly tokens, pilot = 3 months, average response length ~120 tokens per request for generation (affects KV cache usage), embedding tokens counted separately.
- Unit pricing (pilot tier): $4.50 per 1M generation tokens; $1.25 per 1M embedding tokens.
- Monthly estimate (month 1 baseline):
  - Generation: 1,050M * $4.50 / 1M = $4,725
  - Embedding: 150M * $1.25 / 1M = $187.50
  - Platform & storage misc (monitoring, logging): $300
  - Support (priority SRE, 24/7): $1,000
  - Estimated monthly total: $6,212.50
- 3-month pilot total (no discounts applied): $18,637.50

Notes on math: the generation unit price includes batching/throughput optimizations and assumed 70% effective batching given synchronous mixes. Long-term rates may be lower with committed consumption (we can provide 6/12-month reserved pricing options separately).

Attachments: novapay_invoice_estimate_20270403.pdf (one-page invoice-style estimate), novapay_cost_model_20270403.xlsx (detailed workbook with per-route token assumptions, kernel/runtime cost slices, and sensitivity toggles).

Let me know if you want the invoice formatted for PO submission (we can generate a net-30 invoice with company details). If procurement wants a line-item CSV for your AP system I can include that as well.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: novapay_invoice_estimate_20270403.pdf (pdf, 18KB), novapay_cost_model_20270403.xlsx (spreadsheet, 96KB)]
